                                       layout: BNNSDataLayoutVector,

                                       data_type: BNNSDataType.int16,

                                       data_scale: 1, data_bias: 0)

guard let randomNumberGenerator = BNNSCreateRandomGenerator(BNNSRandomGeneratorMethodAES_CTR,
                                                            nil) else {
    return
}

                         -10,
                         10)

data.deallocate()
